newsitem.title: RUSSIA: UES, Surgut lead Russian shares activity.
newsitem.headline: UES, Surgut lead Russian shares activity.

text.p: Shares in Russian utility UES and oil company Surgutneftegaz, both planning new placements soon, firmed on Wednesday morning in a generally quiet share market.
At 1115 GMT, UES had edged up to $0.0826 from $0.0823, which brokers said was in anticipation of an auction of 8.5 percent of UES stock on December 23.
"We have seen big buys and that resumed today," said Pavel Gronbjerg of Deutsche Morgan Grenfell.
Other dealers said Russian firms were also bidding up the stock in expectation of an investor rush for the leading issue.
Surgut, which on Tuesday announced plans to offer American Depositary Receipts for preferred shares, saw those prefs continue to firm, to $0.317 from $0.304, on over five million shares' trade.
But traders, some of whom said the market could fall off slightly towards the end of the year, said there was very little activity in the market.
"There are not that many buyers, and it is the end of the year," said Andrei Ippolitov of Prospekt.
Many dealers said there was unlikely to be strong movement, and volatility has decreased markedly since the July presidential election.

Market volume, which was seen on Wednesday as being about the same as Tuesday's $10 million reported turnover, has also decreased from an average close to the mid-$30 millions late in the election cycle.
Gronbjerg said he had no strong position on the market. "I'd rather be in cash. Neither long nor short."
